evidence.quoted_text:
if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', target):
        raise ValueError('target must be a full commit SHA')
evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, verify_target validates only that target is 40 lowercase hex characters. An annotated tag object ID satisfies that check, and Git's commit-ish operations (merge-base, ls-tree, show, checkout) peel it to the underlying commit, so the deploy checks and detached checkout can succeed while the supplied target is not a commit SHA. That contradicts the function's own 'full commit SHA' requirement and can leave intent/return values referring to the tag object rather than the commit at HEAD. The smallest compatible fix is to require `git cat-file -t <target>` to report `commit` before the ancestry checks.
